# `Ui.ImageSrc`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Ui.ImageSrc — a typed image source (Layer 3 Ipe source).

An `ImageSrc` is a closed sum: either a remote URL (`ImageSrc.url`) or an
inline data URI (`ImageSrc.data`).  The ONLY way to build one is through
these two constructors; a raw `String` cannot reach the `Ui.image` boundary.

`toAttributeValue` produces the string an HTML `src` attribute accepts:
for `url` variants it returns the URL string; for `data` variants it
assembles `data:<mime>;base64,<base64>`.

Importing this module forces the `url` runtime feature because `FromUrl`
embeds `Ipe.Url.Url`, which renders as `ipe_runtime::url::Url` (gated behind
the `url` cargo feature).  The type-driven SSOT
(`ir_type_feature_requirement`) closes this automatically — no explicit
`uses_url` flag is needed.

## `ImageSrc`

An opaque image source: either a remote URL or an inline data URI.
The constructor is NOT exported; build via `url` or `data`.

## `url`

```ipe
url : Url -> ImageSrc
```

`url u` — a remote image identified by a validated `Ipe.Url.Url`.

## `data`

```ipe
data : { mime : String, base64 : String } -> ImageSrc
```

`data { mime, base64 }` — an inline image from base64-encoded bytes.
`mime` is the MIME type (e.g. `"image/png"`); `base64` is the
base64-encoded payload without the `data:` prefix.

## `toAttributeValue`

```ipe
toAttributeValue : ImageSrc -> String
```

`toAttributeValue src` — the string for an HTML `src` attribute.
For a `url` variant: the URL string.
For a `data` variant: `data:<mime>;base64,<base64>`.
